title: Cabin Lake House
description:
Surrounded nature.  Sit out in covered shade listening to the water crash while cruising one of the most popular lakes in Nashville TN.  This pontoon can accommodate 15 passengers.  Options for sun or watch water activities from inside the air conditioned cabin. 
Binge watch shows to view on the 42iin TV screen.   No need to hold pause too long as the boat has your needs for breaks with a bathroom and refrigerator on-board.  
Surplus of seating for eating or lounge.
Has 2nd level for sun bathing
